evidence.claim: Engineering posts describe ClickHouse in the analytics stack.
Careers page lists multiple data-platform openings.
Product materials emphasize live customer-facing dashboards.
As dashboard concurrency grows, complex queries and operational overhead may become a scaling bottleneck.
Public architecture material references Elasticsearch and Loki.
Documentation describes high-volume log ingestion through Kafka.
Maintaining separate search and log systems may create cost and operational complexity worth validating.
The product runs agentic workflows that depend on continuously updated enterprise context.
Recent hiring includes data infrastructure roles.
A unified analytical/context layer could reduce architecture fragmentation as workloads scale.
Technical documentation references Trino and Hive for analytical queries.
A platform engineering position mentions query-serving performance.
Interactive workloads may benefit from a faster serving layer if latency or concurrency is currently limiting users.
